# FatalityDrivenRewiring

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mechanism where nodes with high disease fatality are removed or rewired, causing local network density changes that alter global connectivity patterns. Mimics fault-tolerant reconfiguration in TCC systems, where failed or degraded compute nodes trigger topology re-routing to maintain system resilience.
